senses.gloss: happening repeatedly over a period of time, often with short breaks

definition_translations.ko_KR: 일정 기간 동안 반복적으로 일어나며 종종 짧은 중단이 있는
definition_translations.vi_VN: xảy ra lặp đi lặp lại trong một thời gian, thường có những quãng nghỉ ngắn
definition_translations.th_TH: เกิดขึ้นซ้ำ ๆ ในช่วงเวลาหนึ่ง มักมีช่วงหยุดสั้น ๆ
